metadata.description: A skill factory for data engineers: reverse engineering, SQL, dbt, modeling, pipelines, Fabric, Snowflake, Power BI, quality and ops, persona-tiered architecture docs, and the tooling to create and eval new skills. The Data Warrior is the doctrine.

plugins.name: de-reverse-engineering
plugins.description: Reverse engineer legacy data systems without running them: SQL Server, Snowflake and Fabric catalog inventory, stored procedure specs, SSIS and ADF/Fabric pipeline analysis, sqlglot table lineage, business rules catalog, profiling, and legacy-to-dbt migration with parity testing.

plugins.name: de-sql
plugins.description: SQL craft for data engineers on T-SQL, Snowflake and Spark SQL: style and review, performance tuning with plans, refactoring legacy SQL to set-based and CTE form with parity, and testing SQL.

plugins.name: de-dbt
plugins.description: Opinionated dbt for Fabric, Snowflake and SQL Server: project setup, model development and incremental strategies, tests and contracts, snapshots, and CI/CD with slim CI and environments.

plugins.name: de-modeling
plugins.description: Data modeling for analytics: Kimball dimensional modeling (grain, conformed dimensions, SCD, fact types) and Data Vault 2.0 (hubs, links, satellites, hash keys, PIT and bridge, AutomateDV).

plugins.name: de-pipelines
plugins.description: Pipeline engineering: incremental ingestion (CDC, change tracking, watermarks, snapshots, deletes, late data, schema drift), safe backfill and replay, and Airflow orchestration with dbt.

plugins.name: de-platforms
plugins.description: Platform-deep skills for Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Power BI semantic models and SQL Server as a source: topology, security, capacity and cost, deployment, and the traps each platform has.

plugins.name: de-quality-ops
plugins.description: Keep data trustworthy in production: data quality checks with severity and quarantine, source-to-target reconciliation and financial controls, observability (freshness, volume, schema) and pipeline incident response.

plugins.name: de-architecture-docs
plugins.description: Persona-tiered design docs for data platforms: architecture overview, TDD, ADRs, data model, pipeline specs, contracts, governance, delivery and cost, for the CDO/CIO, the Data Director and the Lead Data Engineer, from one facts file, reviewed by read-only subagents.

plugins.name: de-skill-factory
plugins.description: Make more data engineering skills to one standard: create a new skill, upgrade a thin skill into a deep one, and eval a skill against a no-skill baseline.

plugins.name: data-warrior
plugins.description: The Data Warrior skills (skills only): ground the decision before the build, study trade-offs, win the room, read the void. The full Forge plugin lives upstream.

plugins.name: gordonmurray-data-engineering
plugins.description: Deep, dated expert skills for Apache Iceberg, Paimon, Fluss, Flink, Flink Agents, Iggy, Lance, Firn and Docker Compose, by Gordon Murray.
